title: Quantitative Developer, Cyprus, Dubai, Malaysia
description:
Quantitative Developer - Proprietary Trading Infrastructure
We are partnering with a globally recognised prop trading firm to recruit a Quantitative Developer who will architect and build the core revenue engine from the ground up. This is not a standard software engineering role, it sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, low-latency systems engineering, and brokerage technology.
You will design, build, and optimise a proprietary trading bridge and risk engine that connects a 220,000+ user demo trading platform to real-world Liquidity Providers, identifying alpha and monetising it through high-speed execution. If you have a trader's mindset, a quant's toolbox, and an engineer's discipline, this is the role you've been waiting for!
Who they are
A global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, empowering the world's most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm - 220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.
Your Role in Our Mission
You are not just writing code; you are building a money-making machine. We are seeking a Quantitative Developer with a deep "Trader's Mindset" to design, build, and optimize a proprietary bridge and risk engine.
Your primary mission is to unlock the value in our data. You will build the infrastructure that connects our demo environment to real-world Liquidity Providers (LPs), identifying our best traders and mathematically replicating their success in the live market via high-speed execution.
How You'll Make an Impact
The "Bridge" & Risk Engine

• Architect and build a low-latency "Trading Bridge" that sits between our proprietary platform (MetaTrader/cTrader) and external Liquidity Providers.

• Develop a sophisticated Risk Engine that analyzes thousands of demo traders in real-time to identify "toxic flow" (to hedge) and "alpha flow" (to copy/monetize).

• Implement statistical models that filter noise from trader data to execute profitable replication strategies on real markets.

FIX Protocol & Connectivity

• Act as the subject matter expert on the FIX Protocol (Financial Information eXchange). You will write the custom engines to manage sessions, parse messages, and handle order routing with various LPs and Prime Brokers.

• Build aggregators that connect to multiple venues simultaneously to find the best pricing and execution speed.

Quantitative Modeling & Math

• Apply advanced statistics (Time Series Analysis, Stochastic Calculus) to create pricing models and execution algorithms (TWAP, VWAP, Sniper) that minimize slippage.

• Build a simulation environment that can replay millions of historical retail trades to validate your copy-trading algorithms before live deployment.

High-Frequency & Low-Latency Engineering

• Optimize Python (and potentially C++/Rust modules) for microsecond-level latency. In FX and CFD arbitrage, milliseconds matter.

• Ensure the system can handle massive bursts of quote updates and order events without clogging or crashing (AsyncIO, ZeroMQ, shared memory architectures).

What You Bring

• FIX Protocol Expert: You know the FIX tags by heart (4.2/4.4). You have built or maintained a FIX engine that connects to real LPs.

• Math & Stats Whiz: You have a strong academic or practical background in Mathematics, Statistics, or Quantitative Finance. You understand probability, variance, and risk modeling deeply.

• Python Performance: You don't just write Python; you write fast Python. You know how to use numpy, pandas, cython, and asyncio to squeeze every bit of performance out of the interpreter.

• Trading Architecture: Experience building Order Management Systems (OMS) or Execution Management Systems (EMS).

• Brokerage Tech: Deep understanding of how Forex Brokers, ECNs, and Liquidity Providers operate (A-Book vs. B-Book execution, slippage

Vendor Type
When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.
Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?
A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. title: Technical Program Manager, Storage & Data Infrastructure
description:
About the Team

OpenAI's data and storage infrastructure spans data platforms, online databases, and file/object storage. These systems underpin data ingestion and processing, durable persistence, indexing and retrieval, and product file experiences. As frontier models and agents evolve how they use memory, history and snapshots, the underlying architecture increasingly shapes the capabilities products can deliver-and their latency, reliability, cost and efficiency.

About the Role

We are looking for a technically deep TPM to independently define and lead multiple programs across data platforms, online databases and storage infrastructure. You will connect model, product and data-consumer requirements to architecture, and work with the relevant engineering teams to take new capabilities through production adoption and repeatable expansion.

The design scope is exabyte-scale storage and infrastructure spanning multiple millions of CPU cores. The challenge is not simply forecasting more resources: it is making complete, workload-ready capacity repeatable, with a clear path from product requirements through architecture, deployment and validation. A data pipeline, database query, file operation or execution snapshot can affect whether a product or agent succeeds; you will connect those outcomes to the systems underneath.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Translate model, product and data-platform needs into precise access patterns, consistency, durability, freshness, availability and scalability requirements. Connect memory, history, retrieval and resumable work to capability and end-to-end latency.

- Partner with engineering to transform data and storage architecture into repeatable scale units: standardized provisioning, placement, routing, data movement and readiness checks that bring storage, compute and networking online together. Tie each expansion to the workloads it can serve.

- Lead cross-stack programs connecting ingestion and processing, databases and indexes, and file/object storage. Make data ownership, schema compatibility, change-data-capture, replay and consumer-readiness contracts explicit so the full data path remains correct and usable.

- Make cost and efficiency architectural inputs. Evaluate physical versus logical footprint, index and replication amplification, redundant copies, tiering, caching and network movement against the cost of serving useful workloads.

- Drive resilience and recovery programs with explicit failure scenarios and validation. Distinguish database backup, failover and point-in-time recovery from execution/workspace save-and-restore; verify correctness, recovery time, safe resumption and isolation from live traffic.

- Coordinate lifecycle correctness across files, objects, databases and data platforms, including metadata, retention, deletion and snapshots. Incorporate privacy, access control, auditability and residency requirements into the design and consumer contracts.

- Lead adoption and major migrations through compatibility checks, representative workload testing, staged cutovers, rollback and operational handoff. Improve APIs, guardrails and self-service so new capacity and capabilities can be consumed predictably.

- Measure architecture changes through product and platform outcomes: task completion and continuity, data freshness, query/retrieval and snapshot latency, throughput, reliability and cost/efficiency. Use those results to drive durable performance and operational improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have independently owned complex production programs in data platforms, databases or storage infrastructure and can explain the architectural decisions, your contribution and the resulting impact.

- Have deep working knowledge of hyperscaler/cloud storage technologies, such as Amazon S3 or Azure Blob Stor

title: Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy
description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple--districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will build and lead the communications, research, and narrative infrastructure necessary to make proportional representation one of the defining democracy reform movements of the 21st century.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will lead all communications, narrative development, public opinion research, digital engagement, media relations, and strategic communications efforts for the Proportional Representation Hub .

This executive will be responsible for shaping how policymakers, voters, journalists, funders, advocates, and opinion leaders understand proportional representation, in the context of other democracy reforms. They will oversee the communications strategies supporting federal, state, and local campaigns while simultaneously building a long-term narrative change effort to help transform the national conversation about democracy and move the idea of proportional representation from the margins to the mainstream.

The Vice President will oversee communications consultants, research firms, polling vendors, creative agencies, digital partners, media strategists, and public affairs consultants. They will also help build communications capacity throughout the broader democracy reform ecosystem, providing strategic guidance and technical support to allied organizations and campaign partners.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE bridges the gap using real attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale. We partner closely with Fraud, Risk and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments, balancing aggressive risk mitigation against legitimate user conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites in partnership with Abuse Research to permanently block threat recurrence and seamlessly transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Control Engineer on the Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors.

 

Where emerging threat patterns identify Stripe product weaknesses, ACE steps in to rapidly build and experiment with technical safeguards. Driven by empirical evidence and Stripe’s FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into hard technical control requirements (e.g., API rate-limiting, step-up challenges, parameter validation, pre-debit holds).  You will carefully balance security and product velocity, running experiments to evaluate risk reduction against user conversion impact. Managing controls through a strict incubation lifecycle, you will build automated regression suites to prevent recurrence and partner with native product teams to hand off mature, long-term defenses.  

Responsibilities

• Rapid Control Prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to immediately close high-impact abuse vectors.  Evidence-Based Technical Requirements: Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research Abuse Research, Fraud and Security into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications. 

• Control Co-Design: Collaborate closely with teams across Stripe to co-design resilient, secure controls across payment, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces.   

• Risk Experimentation: Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against legitimate user conversion impact, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats.  

• Regression Testing: Build comprehensive regression testing suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur. 

• Stakeholder Management: Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, and target dates to transfer successful controls to product teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Software Engineering, Application Security, or Anti-Abuse Engineering in a high-scale production environment.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong software development background with expert proficiency in Pyth

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
About Goods & Services

Goods & Services is a product design and engineering company.
We solve mission-critical challenges for some of the world’s largest enterprises, with deep expertise in highly regulated industries-including life sciences and financial services . Our design-led approach allows us to apply cutting-edge capabilities in AI, Data and Hardware Engineering to companies of any size.
Headquartered in the United States , we operate regional development centers in Mexico and the United Kingdom . This global footprint-anchored by our nearshore model-enables us to deliver at scale with the speed, efficiency, and cultural alignment our clients expect.
About the job

Goods & Services is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer who is responsible for hands-on implementation, maintenance, and operational support of modern lakehouse platforms, with a focus on Microsoft Fabric / OneLake.
In this role, you will participate in the full lifecycle from requirements to deployment and production support, translating business needs into reliable data products while ensuring data quality, monitoring, and performance. You will work closely with Solution Architects to follow platform standards across multiple engagements.
What you’ll do:

• Ensure data quality and reliability by implementing data quality checks, monitoring anomalies, performing root cause analysis on pipeline failures, and proactively identifying and resolving data or process issues impacting reliability, cost, or stakeholder trust.

• Implementation & Operations: Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and orchestration components (e.g., Fabric Data Pipelines, notebooks) for patterns such as file drops, APIs, and database extracts.

• Reliability & Quality: Ensure data integrity by implementing quality checks, monitoring anomalies, and performing root cause analysis on pipeline failures.

• Architecture & Modeling: Develop curated transformation layers (Silver/Gold) aligned to defined grains and keys to publish reliable data products.

• Operational Excellence: Operate and monitor platform components (schedules, alerts, runbooks) and maintain accurate “as-built” technical documentation.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with analytics/BI teams to ensure datasets support reporting needs and assist with validation and adoption.

What you’ll need:

• 5+ years’ years in Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, or Lakehouse projects.

• Proficiency in Python or Spark-based transformations and strong SQL skills for complex query analysis.

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric (preferred) or similar cloud data environments and orchestration tools.

• Deep understanding of Delta table concepts (partitioning, schema evolution) and dimensional data modeling (grain/keys).

• Proven ability to manage the full development lifecycle and troubleshoot performance problems across ingestion and consumption layers.

• Ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms and work effectively in a team environment.

Nice to have:

• Familiarity with reporting/semantic consumption patterns (Power BI familiarity is a plus).

• Comfort working in a client-services environment (multiple engagements, shifting priorities, clear communication, strong documentation).

• Knowledge of multi-unit retail/restaurant analytics is helpful but not required.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence – Fashion & Luxury AI Venture | BIANCO VENTURES
description:
Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury. Uniamo capitale, execution e conoscenza profonda del mercato fin dal primo giorno, insieme a partner come Deloitte, GELLIFY e ARAD, per costruire nuove imprese con chi conosce il settore dall'interno.
Non siamo un fondo. Non siamo un acceleratore. Costruiamo imprese vere, partendo da problemi veri.
La venture oggetto di questa ricerca è la prima iniziativa live del nostro ecosistema. Stiamo cercando la persona che la guidi.
La sfida
Nelle organizzazioni retail distribuite, decine, centinaia di punti vendita, mercati diversi, team locali con autonomia operativa, il coordinamento tra struttura centrale e rete è uno dei problemi più persistenti e ancora poco risolti dalla tecnologia.
Le linee guida partono dall'HQ. Cosa succede dopo è spesso invisibile. L'execution reale, la qualità con cui le direttive diventano azione nei singoli store, viene misurata tardi, se viene misurata. I dati ci sono, ma sono frammentati, manuali, non strutturati.
Questo è il problema che stiamo affrontando.
La venture
Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma B2B software e AI focalizzata sulla retail execution e sull'operational intelligence per il Fashion, il Luxury e il Retail mid-market.
La venture nasce da un'analisi concreta del mercato e da interlocuzioni dirette con i decision maker del settore. La tesi di mercato è sviluppata. La value proposition iniziale è strutturata. Il problema è reale e ancora largamente irrisolto dagli strumenti oggi disponibili.
Siamo in fase early-stage. Il prodotto e il modello di business devono ancora essere validati e costruiti, questa è esattamente la ragione per cui stiamo cercando chi voglia farlo.
Il ruolo
Cerchiamo un'Entrepreneur in Residence che agisca come founder operativa/o della venture.
Non si tratta di un incarico consulenziale. Non è un ruolo di product management interno. Non è innovation management.
È ownership reale di un'impresa in costruzione: dalla customer discovery alla prima revenue, dalla definizione del prodotto alla creazione del team, dal go-to-market alla preparazione allo spin-off.
Avrai autonomia concreta. Avrai il supporto di un ecosistema attivo. Avrai accesso a stakeholder industriali che raramente si trovano nella stessa stanza.
Cosa farai nei primi 6-9 mesi
Nei primi mesi costruirai le fondamenta operative e commerciali della venture. In concreto:

• Approfondirai la customer discovery, intervistando Retail Director, Head of VM, COO e altri decision maker del settore, per validare il problema e misurare la willingness to pay

• Raffinerai la value proposition in dialogo con il mercato reale, non con ipotesi interne

• Coordinerai la costruzione dell'MVP con il team tecnologico, definendo le priorità di prodotto in funzione di ciò che hai imparato sul campo

• Progetterai e gestirai i primi pilot con brand selezionati, raccogliendo evidenze qualitative e quantitative

• Definirai il modello commerciale (pricing, segmentazione, struttura contrattuale) partendo dai dati, non da benchmark generici

• Costruirai il go-to-market iniziale e acquisirai i primi clienti paganti

• Coordinerai partner tecnologici, fornitori e risorse dedicate

• Definirai KPI e milestone della venture e le presenterai agli stakeholder e ai potenziali investitori

• Costruirai il primo team intorno alla venture

• Preparerai la società allo spin-off e al fundraising seed
Chi cerchiamo
Consideriamo profili con 5-10 anni di esperienza che abbiano lavorato in almeno uno di questi ambiti: startup early-stage, venture building, product management B2B, growth, SaaS enterprise, retail tech, AI o innovation.
Quello che non è negoziabile:

• Capacità di condurre customer discovery in contesti enterprise, sapere ascoltare, sapere sintetizzare, sapere cambiare idea quando i dati lo richiedono

• Attitudine commerciale: saper portare una soluzione davanti a un buyer, gestire il ciclo di vendita, chiudere

title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.

• Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.

• Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep

• Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to facilitate global communication both internally and with external customers.

Notre ambition future est de devenir une entreprise de technologie de santé grand public de premier plan tout en continuant à développer des solutions pour des problèmes de santé graves. Nous y parviendrons en réinventant constamment des expériences uniques basées sur la biosurveillance. Bien que nous ayons parcouru un long chemin depuis nos débuts modestes, nos rêves sont plus grands que jamais. L’opportunité d’améliorer la santé à l’échelle mondiale est devant nous.

Chez Dexcom , nous transformons la prise en charge du diabète grâce à des technologies innovantes de surveillance continue du glucose (CGM) qui améliorent concrètement la vie des patients. En tant que Senior Manager Accès au Marché & Affaires Publiques, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au sein de la filiale française en contribuant directement à l'élargissement de l'accès des patients aux solutions Dexcom .
À l'interface entre les autorités de santé, les payeurs, les décideurs institutionnels et les équipes internes, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre les stratégies permettant de démontrer la valeur clinique, économique et organisationnelle de nos technologies.

• Vous définissez et mettez en œuvre la stratégie d'accès au marché de Dexcom en France pour l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits et services, en cohérence avec les objectifs de la filiale et de la région EMEA.

• Vous identifiez les besoins en génération de données médico-économiques, d'études d'impact budgétaire et de Real-World Evidence afin de renforcer les démonstrations de valeur des technologies Dexcom .

OpenAI is hiring a Senior Manager, Financial Reporting to help build and run a best-in-class financial reporting engine in a technically complex, rapidly evolving, and high-growth environment. We are looking for a seasoned external reporting professional who pairs strong technical judgment with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset - owning key reporting deliverables, driving rigorous tie-outs and disclosure quality, and converting ambiguity into audit-ready output. This role will collaborate closely with teams across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and Investor Relations to improve reporting processes, streamline data flows, and elevate how financial information is communicated across stakeholders.

- Improve scalability and reduce manual effort - Identify and implement process improvements, standard templates, and control points to simplify workflows, increase automation where possible, and raise the overall quality bar as the company grows.

- Strong track record of successfully managing end-to-end reporting, consistently delivering accurate, audit-ready documentation.

- Proven project management and communication skills, adept at simplifying and conveying complex financial information clearly to diverse stakeholders, including executives, boards, and investors.

- Active CPA license and deep technical accounting knowledge, with proven expertise in researching standards, preparing technical memos, and managing complex accounting transactions.

title: Head of Sourcing Enablement & Delivery
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement helps OpenAI secure the products, services, and partnerships that support our research, build our products, and grow our business. We work with teams across the company to make sound commercial decisions and move important work forward.

As OpenAI grows, we are rethinking how sourcing works: bringing expertise into decisions earlier, simplifying contracting, and using AI to give Procurement more time for judgment and strategic work. What we learn internally-and through our supplier and enterprise-buyer relationships-can also inform better products, partnerships, and industry adoption.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a senior leader to head Sourcing Enablement & Delivery, leading sourcing operational delivery, contracting enablement, and AI transformation-and building Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI’s commercial growth. You will build the teams, systems, service model, and cross-functional partnerships that enable sourcing and contracting at scale, helping teams move quickly without losing commercial discipline or accountability.

You will partner with GTM, Sales, and Partnerships to develop Procurement’s contribution to OpenAI adoption and commercial growth. Bring procurement-industry knowledge, buyer insights, and lessons from internal AI use into customer engagement, product feedback, and opportunities across the procurement ecosystem.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Sourcing, you will manage the Sourcing Delivery and Contract Management leaders and shape this new function’s priorities, team, and measures of success.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

PRIORITIES AND WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- A focused roadmap: clear choices about what to build first, what to defer, and how progress will be measured.

- Stronger delivery: capable leaders and teams, faster execution, less rework, and fewer unresolved ownership gaps.

- AI adoption: sustained use of AI-enabled capabilities, with measurable gains in quality, capacity, and user experience.

- Commercial results: increased OpenAI adoption across the procurement industry and a measurable contribution to commercial growth, consistent with independent supplier selection and purchasing decisions.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build and lead the organization. Hire and develop managers, coach performance, and build succession and leadership depth. Decide how employees, contractors, delivery partners, and AI share the work. Hold leaders accountable for results, capacity, and team health.

- Own sourcing enablement and delivery operations. Set service commitments and quality standards with the Delivery and Contract Management leaders. Match support to deal complexity and risk, and use internal customer feedback to improve the service. Category and Sourcing leads retain ownership of their strategies and deals, including supplier selection, negotiations, and purchasing.

- Lead the sourcing operating rhythm. Bring demand, priorities, and capacity into one forward plan, informed by workload and performance data. Work with category leaders to make tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and follow through on commitments. Provide inputs to Procurement-wide planning and functional business reviews.

- Strengthen contracting. Partner with Legal and Procurement Operations/COE on contract lifecycle management, approved templates, and negotiation playbooks that improve quality and free category teams to focus on strategic deals.

- Lead RACI development. Define responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths within Procurement and across partner teams. Define how the team prioritizes work, allocates resources, and resolves delivery issues.

- Create mechanisms to bring sourcing into decisions earlier: connect business demand, supplier activity, and renewals-including work outside formal intake-with Sourcing teams

At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack - from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues - they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

- True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design - from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

- AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

- Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

- Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

- AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

- Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively - scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

- Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

- Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

- Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

- Fluency with AI tooling: Practical exp

title: Facility Operator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands

.

ROLE SCOPE

- Serve as the on-site SME for data center critical infrastructure, handling escalations across the white space and the supporting facilities.

- Understand and manage the design limitations and risks of the site, and audit colocation partners and service providers on their maintenance programs and effectiveness.

- Own the change management process for high-risk maintenance activities in the data center.

- Act as first responder on-site for incidents, driving resolution with support from engineering and infrastructure SMEs.

- Partner with colo partners, vendors, and internal teams to keep the site reliable, and feed operational learnings back into design and process.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've operated or led critical-facilities operations in a live data center, owning the physical infrastructure that keeps a site running.

- You know the critical-infrastructure stack (power and cooling) well enough to be the on-site authority and handle escalations.

- You run change management for high-risk work and hold partners to a real maintenance standard.

- You're a calm, capable first responder when something fails at 3am.

- You audit, document, and improve, leaving the site's operating posture stronger than you found it.

- Bonus: Hyperscale or colocation operations. Uptime Institute or NFPA familiarity. Critical

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

Experience

• Knowledge of database technologies and SQL, along with API testing using OpenAPI, Swagger or gRPC.

Leadership and Quality Expertise

description:

Senior Field Clinical Engineer - Talent Pool
(Remote with up to 50% travel; desired candidate'ss location: Prague, Czech Republic)
Please note- this is only an opportunity to join our Talent Comunity, it is not linked to a specific vacancy.
About This Role
At Boston Scientific , your work helps advance innovative cardiac technologies that improve patients’ lives. As a Senior Field Clinical Engineer , you will play a key, hands-on role in supporting both pre- and post-market clinical trials, working directly with leading cardiac centers in Czechia and across Europe.
This role is ideal for someone who values autonomy, ownership, and close collaboration with clinicians . You will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of clinical trial activities at assigned sites, acting as a trusted clinical and technical partner for investigators and hospital teams. The position offers strong visibility within an international clinical organization and exposure to European-level clinical programs.
The role is based in the Czech Republic and requires regular travel within Czechia and across Europe to support clinical activities.
Work mode: Remote, with up to 50% travel.
The Opportunity:
In this role, you will serve as a key clinical interface between Boston Scientific and investigational sites. You will support studies from early site engagement through patient enrollment and follow-up, directly contributing to study quality, patient safety, and the successful development of future cardiac therapies.
You will work independently in the field while remaining closely connected to a collaborative, international clinical team.
What You Will Do:

• Own the day-to-day execution of clinical trials within your assigned territory, ensuring sites are prepared, supported, and engaged throughout the study lifecycle.

• Act as the primary point of contact for investigators and site staff, providing clinical, technical, and procedural expertise.

• Support site qualification, initiation, and enrollment readiness activities, including IRB support and investigator training.

• Deliver hands-on technical support during electrophysiology (EP) procedures and follow-up visits, working directly in cath lab and clinical environments.

• Build trusted, long-term relationships with physicians and clinical teams, supporting sustained engagement in clinical programs.

• Lead clinical initiatives and projects, contributing to continuous improvement of study execution and site performance.

• Collaborate closely with internal clinical, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders to ensure aligned and effective trial delivery.

What You Bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline.

• Experience in the medical device industry, clinical research, field clinical engineering, sales support, or as a cardiac physiologist.

• Hands-on experience in electrophysiology (EP) ablation procedures.

• Ability to work independently in a field-based role, with a proactive and collaborative mindset.

• Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with physicians and clinical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel within Europe.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with EP mapped ablation procedures

• Familiarity with clinical trial operations, site management, and clinical documentation

What We Offer:
At Boston Scientific , we support our employees both professionally and personally. In this role, you can expect:

• Private medical care, lunch card and life insurance

• Annual performance-based bonus

• Company car or car allowance to support frequent travel within Czechia and across Europe

• Flexible working model with a remote setup and autonomy in organizing your field activities

• Continuous learning and development opportunities, including technical training, clinical educatio

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Description

We are hiring a Technical Recruiter to support Plaid’s growing Engineering organization. You will own full-cycle recruiting across a few GenSWE pipelines.

As a full-cycle recruiter, you will partner closely with technical and business leaders to drive searches from sourcing through close. You will build and manage high-quality pipelines, design and execute recruiting strategies, and provide data-driven insights that guide hiring decisions. You will act as a trusted advisor to your stakeholders while championing a candidate-first experience that reflects Plaid’s values and high standards.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility opportunity where your work will directly influence how Plaid builds its technical organization and scales to meet ambitious goals.

Responsibilities:

- Own full-cycle recruiting for GenSWE roles, from sourcing and outreach through final rounds and offer close.
